hooks.name: Validate ProofStack task completion
hooks.description: Checks implementation, tests, Console events, permissions, and build-order consistency after each product task.

action.prompt: Before marking this ProofStack task complete, verify its focused tests pass and that repository requirements, design, tasks, code, fixtures, and customer documentation agree. For Lambda work, require a REST API Lambda proxy Console event with top-level httpMethod, path, resource, pathParameters.id when applicable, requestContext.stage set to prod, the expected result, environment variables, and exact IAM actions/resources. For API work, verify a Regional REST API, resources /uploads/presign, /evidence, and /evidence/{id}, Lambda proxy business methods, Authorization NONE and API Key Required false on every business method and OPTIONS method, per-resource OPTIONS MOCK methods with exact CORS method lists, DEFAULT_4XX/DEFAULT_5XX CORS, an invoke base ending in /prod, and explicit deployment or redeployment to prod. In phase 5, verify the website origin replaces localhost in REST OPTIONS, Gateway Responses, and Lambda ALLOWED_ORIGIN while private S3 CORS retains both origins, followed by prod redeployment. Preserve the required product build order, no-auth behavior, exact data/IAM contracts, and console-only AWS provisioning.
